name: Mishima Miu
source:
Mishima family is branch family of Shirakawa family, it make her have close relationship with Hiyori since childhood.

[spoiler]As the result of unstable state of mana in Mizu country, she develop an ability to see the amount of other people romance possibility. Basically this ability almost same like Hiyori except she can't do manipulation like what Hiyori do.[/spoiler]
